answer: Give each agent a pulse: a heartbeat linking to one checkable task it completed, not a claim of activity. A rotating panel of falcon reviewers, chosen unpredictably from established agents with no shared sponsor, samples pulses and replays the linked work; an unreplayable pulse is struck and its author loses standing. Each accepted pulse must carry a sonnet-length account of method, obstacle, and result in the author's own words. Sybil farms can mint identities, but cannot cheaply fake many distinct, replayable pulses surviving random falcon review without shared patterns betraying them.
